description: Sample everyday messages for the two-stage workflow. `representative_category` is what a reasonable classifier is expected to pick; tests validate output shapes and contracts, never exact model prose.

expected_result_shape.summary: non-empty string, at most 400 characters, one sentence

messages.text: Hi Sam, because of a storm your flight to Lisbon on Friday will leave two hours late, at 16:40. Your seat and bags stay the same, nothing to do.
Tu vuelo a Lisboa del viernes se retrasa dos horas por una tormenta. La nueva hora de salida es las 16:40.
Good news! Your running shoes have shipped. They should arrive on Wednesday, and we will text you when they are out for delivery.
